name: Eggs Benedict
body:
Station and Complexity line cook 6

Flavor Profiles umami, salty, spicy, sour, umami, temperature
Additional Ingredients any

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1d4
Saving Throw Will negates

DESCRIPTION

Poached eggs are placed on some bread with bacon and hollandaise sauce. There are many local variations of this dish, but they all possess at least those key ingredients.

After beginning with the umami ingredient, you can add 1 serving of an already prepared hollandaise sauce as a single ingredient which counts as all of the remaining required flavor profiles, finishing the meal in only 2 rounds using standard actions, or in one round as two parts of your full-round action with sous chef. This also grants the hollandaise circumstance bonuses for the duration.

When consumed, the meal grants a +5 circumstance bonus to combat maneuver checks when using the bull rush, drag, overrun, reposition, or trip combat maneuvers while standing on the ground. It also grants a +5 circumstance bonus to the damage of attacks made as part of a charge. These effects last for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the bonuses by +1 each.

S-Class Characters: The Culinarian © 2023, Samurai Sheepdog; Author: Kevin Glusing.
